_comment: Sweep candidate c040 (two-stage, NMOS switched input, half size) in standard-cell rows, top row first, each row mirrored about the centre: input pair and tail, preamp resets, the PMOS latch stack (outer-on, cross, inner-on), the NMOS latch (cross-coupled pair split cross-quad over two rows), standard-cell output stage.
